newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.5 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.5 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, April 23 are expected to total $1.5 billion in 27 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.4 billion in 13 sales, with a $543 million NYC Municipal Assistance Corp. deal through J.P. Morgan Securities Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 14 sales totaling $58 million are on the schedule. A $44 million Norfolk, Va., deal at 1030 EDT is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $77 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Wednesday, depending on market conditions.
